findings.title: Null strategy test path skips required rolling-updates feature
findings.body: In UpgradeTest.java createInitialDeployment() returns early when updateStrategy is null without enabling the rolling-updates feature, while the non-null path enables it via FeatureSpec. The same PR documents that the Operator will fail while in preview unless the rolling-updates feature is enabled. As a result the parameterized runs with null (testImageChange-null, testCacheMaxCount-null) deploy a Keycloak CR without the required feature and will fail reconciliation or test different behavior than the RECREATE runs. The feature enablement must happen before the early return for all strategies.

findings.title: Feature gate only tested for metadata, not check, and exit code not verified
findings.body: UpdateCommandDistTest.java adds testFeatureNotEnabled only for update-compatibility metadata when rolling-updates is disabled, but the PR adds the identical gate to update-compatibility check (UpdateCompatibilityCheck.java) with a new exit code FEATURE_DISABLED=4. There is no test that check without the feature prints the disabled message and exits with 4, and the existing test does not assert the exit code. A regression in the check path or wrong exit code would not be caught despite docs promising exit code 4 for disabled feature.
